jobs.mutation.dealTypeHelp: Decides which half of your finance profile applies to this job's listings, and how their affordability is judged.
jobs.mutation.providersHelp: A provider is essentially the service (e.g. ImmoScout24, Kleinanzeigen) that Fredy searches for new listings. Fredy will open a new tab pointing to the website of this provider. You have to adjust your search parameter and click on "Search". If the results are being shown, copy the browser URL in here.
jobs.mutation.notificationsHelp: Fredy supports multiple ways to notify you about new findings. These are called notification adapter. You can chose between email, Telegram etc.
jobs.mutation.blacklistHelp: If a listing contains one of these words, it will be filtered out. Type in a word, then hit enter.
jobs.mutation.criteriaFilterHelp: Filter listings by specific criteria. Only numbers are allowed. You can leave fields empty if you don't want to filter by them.

jobs.mutation.areaFilterHelp: Define multiple geographic areas on the map to filter listings. Start drawing by clicking on the square symbol in the top left corner of the map. Click on the map to add points of the polygon. Select the first point to close the polygon. After that, click on a free area of the map to apply this polygon (the color will change from yellow to blue). To delete a polygon, select it first and then click on the trash symbol.
jobs.mutation.sharingHelp: You can share this job with other users. They will be able to see the listings, but only (as the creator) you can edit the job. Admins are filtered from this list as they have access to everything.
jobs.mutation.sharingNoUsers: No users found to share this Job to. Please create additional non-admin user.
jobs.mutation.activationHelp: Whether or not the job is activated. Inactive jobs will be ignored when Fredy checks for new listings.

listings.filterWatchHelp: Filter by watchlist membership: All shows every listing, Watched only those you saved to your watchlist, Unwatched only those you have not saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.portHelp: The port on which Fredy is running.
settings.baseUrlHelp: Public URL where Fredy is reachable (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9998). Used for 'Open in Fredy' links in notifications.
settings.sessionTTLHelp: Number of hours a session stays valid without activity. Every request extends the session, so a user is only logged out after being inactive for this long. Note: A high TTL might be a security issue as a stolen session cookie can be used to login on your behalf. Please remove all cookies and restart Fredy after changing this.
settings.sqlitePathHelp: The directory where Fredy stores its SQLite database files.
settings.sqlitePathWarning: Changing this path may result in data loss. Restart Fredy immediately after saving.
settings.analyticsHelp: Anonymous usage data to help improve Fredy - provider names, adapter names, OS, Node version, and architecture.
settings.demoModeHelp: In demo mode, Fredy only runs the built-in Demo-Job. Everything else resets to defaults at midnight.
settings.searchIntervalHelp: Interval in minutes for running queries against configured services. Do not go below 5 minutes to avoid being detected as a bot.
settings.workingHoursHelp: Fredy will only search for listings during these hours. Leave empty to search around the clock.
settings.proxyUrlHelp: Optional. Routes the scraping browser through a proxy. Server/datacenter IPs are frequently blocked by providers (e.g. immowelt) regardless of browser fingerprint, a German residential proxy makes requests look like a normal household and is the most effective fix. Format: http://user:pass@host:port or socks5://user:pass@host:port. Leave empty to disable.
settings.homeAddressesHelp: Used to calculate the distance between each address and every listing. Updating these recalculates distances for all active listings.
settings.homeAddressHelp: Used to calculate distances between your location and each listing. Updating this recalculates distances for all active listings.
settings.homeAddressGeoError: Address found but could not be geocoded accurately.
settings.providerDetailsHelp: Fetch additional details (description, attributes, agent info) for listings. Needs an extra API call per listing.
settings.providerDetailsWarning: Enabling this significantly increases API requests to providers that have implemented this feature, raising the chance of rate limiting or blocking. Use at your own risk.
settings.providerDetailsPlaceholder: Select providers to fetch details from...
settings.blacklistFilterOnProviderDetail: When enabled, the blacklist is re-checked against the full description loaded by the Provider Details step above. This catches spam advertisers (e.g. 'allkauf', 'massa') that only appear deep in the detail page and not in the short search-result snippet. Off by default, because the full description often contains generic boilerplate (contact info, legal text) that may accidentally trigger a blacklist term and remove otherwise relevant listings. Has no effect on providers for which Provider Details is not enabled.
Apply blacklist to the full detail description
settings.listingDeletionHelp: Choose the default deletion mode. Soft delete hides them without re-scraping; hard delete removes them from the database.
settings.listingDeletionSoftDesc: Listings are kept in the database but marked as hidden. They will not re-appear during the next scraping session.
settings.listingDeletionHardDesc: Listings are completely removed from the database.
settings.listingDeletionHardConsequence: Consequence: They might re-appear when scraping the next time because Fredy won't know they were previously found.
settings.userSettingsSaved: Settings saved. Distance calculations are running in the background.

settings.backupRestoreCompleted: Restore completed. Please restart the Fredy backend now!
settings.toastWorkingHoursIncomplete: Working hours to and from must be set if either to or from has been set before.
settings.toastSqlitePathEmpty: SQLite db path cannot be empty.
settings.toastSavedReloading: Settings stored successfully. We will reload your browser in 3 seconds.
settings.toastSaveError: Error while trying to store settings.
settings.debugInfoDescription: When enabled, Fredy records every log line (debug, info, warn and error) into its database. A maximum of 5 MB is kept; once the cap is reached, the oldest entries are dropped automatically. Console output is unaffected.
settings.debugConfirmReenableMessage: Debug logs from a previous session are still stored. Do you want to delete them before enabling debug logging again?
settings.debugToastDownloadError: Could not download the debug bundle.
settings.debugToastNoLogs: No debug logs available yet. Enable debug logging first and reproduce the issue.

watchlist.activityChanges: Listing state changes (e.g. listing becomes inactive)
watchlist.addNotificationDescription: When something has changed, Fredy will notify you using the selected notification adapter. Note, some adapter like SqLite are not available here.
notification.description: When Fredy finds new listings, we like to report them to you. To do so, notification adapter can be configured. There are multiple ways how Fredy can send new listings to you. Chose your weapon...

tracking.paragraph1: Fed up with popups? Yeah, me too. But this one's important, and I promise it will only appear once ;)
tracking.paragraph2: Fredy is completely free (and will always remain free). If you'd like, you can support me by donating through my GitHub, but there's absolutely no obligation to do so.
tracking.paragraph3: However, it would be a huge help if you'd allow me to collect some analytical data. Wait, before you click "no", let me explain. If you agree, Fredy will send a ping once every 6 hours to my internal tracking project. (Will be open-sourced soon)
tracking.paragraph4: The data includes: names of active adapters/providers, OS, architecture, Node version, and language. The information is entirely anonymous and helps me understand which adapters/providers are most frequently used.
donate.title: Fredy charges no commission
donate.paragraph1: Fredy searches the portals for you, day and night. No coffee breaks, no commission, no "sorry, already taken".
donate.paragraph2: There is still a human behind it, spending evenings fixing broken providers. If Fredy found you a place, or at least saved your nerves, a tip is very welcome.
donate.fine: Fredy stays free. No subscription, no paywall, no second popup.

finance.title: Financing calculator
finance.intro: Work out what a property would actually cost you every month, and which of the listings you have collected you could realistically buy.
finance.rule.label: How this is calculated:
finance.rule.body: Housing costs plus existing loan payments should stay at or below 35 % of your net income. Up to 40 % a listing counts as a stretch, beyond that as out of reach. Housing costs mean the warm rent when renting and the loan instalment when buying. The amount also has to fit what is left after your living costs.
finance.disclaimer: An estimate based on standard German purchase costs, not financial advice. Ask your bank for a binding offer.
finance.saveHintRent: Saving applies this to your renting jobs and unlocks the affordability filter.
finance.saveBlockedRent: Enter an income and your living costs above to save renting.
finance.saveHintBuy: Saving applies this to your buying jobs and unlocks the affordability filter.
finance.saveBlockedBuy: Enter an income, living costs and your equity to save buying.
finance.delete.confirmRent: Your renting data is removed from settings. Rental listings stop being judged until you save it again. Your household stays.
finance.delete.confirmBuy: Your buying data is removed from settings. Purchase listings stop being judged until you save it again. Your household stays.
finance.area.rentLead: Applies to jobs searching for a place to rent. Uses your income and living costs above.
finance.area.buyLead: Applies to jobs searching for a place to buy. Add equity, the property and your loan terms.
finance.rent.nebenkostenHelp: A percentage on top of the cold rent, not an amount in euros: Betriebskosten, heating, water. Typically 20-30 %, higher in older or poorly insulated buildings. Leave it blank and Fredy uses {{pct}} %.
finance.rent.resultHelp: The most you can pay while housing stays inside 35 % of your net income. Listings quote the cold rent, but your budget pays warm, so set the surcharge first.
finance.rent.needsHousehold: Enter an income and your living costs above to see what you can rent.
finance.rent.maxColdHelp: The highest cold rent, as a listing quotes it, that keeps your warm rent inside 35 % of your net income.
finance.rent.maxWarmHelp: The same ceiling as actually paid: cold rent plus your Nebenkosten percentage. This is the figure your budget sees.
finance.rent.stretchColdHelp: Cold rent up to which a flat is still payable but tight - between the 35 % rule and 40 % of your net income.
finance.rent.disposableHelp: Income minus living costs and existing debt, before any rent. Plain cash flow: the 35 % rule does not enter into it.
finance.verdict.affordableDetail: Affordable - {{rate}} a month, {{percent}} % of your net income
finance.verdict.stretchDetail: A stretch - {{rate}} a month, {{percent}} % of your net income
finance.verdict.unaffordableDetail: Out of reach - {{rate}} a month, {{percent}} % of your net income
finance.verdict.advice: The 35 % rule puts you at {{rate}} a month, which buys about {{price}}.
finance.verdict.adviceNoRoom: Your living costs and existing debt leave nothing for a mortgage payment.
finance.form.householdHelp: Net monthly income after tax. Add a partner to count both incomes.
finance.form.addPartnerHint: Turn this on to count a second income.
finance.form.ageHelp: Used to work out how old you will be when the loan is repaid. It does not change the monthly rate.
finance.form.primaryIncomeHelp: Net salary after tax, per month. Everything else scales with it: the 35 % ceiling, the rate you can afford and the maximum price.
finance.form.secondaryIncomeHelp: Regular extras a bank would count - child benefit, rental income, a second job. Added on top of the net income.
finance.form.outgoingsHelp: What leaves your account every month, before any mortgage payment.
finance.form.livingCostsHelp: Everything except rent: food, insurance, car, utilities. Taken off your income before anything is left for a mortgage, so a higher figure lowers the rate you can afford.
finance.form.existingDebtHelp: Loans you are already paying off. They share the same 35 % ceiling.
finance.form.existingDebtAmountHelp: What you still owe on car loans, consumer credit and the like. Together with the payment below it decides when that loan is cleared.
finance.form.existingDebtRateHelp: What you pay for that loan each month. It counts against the same 35 % ceiling as the mortgage, so it directly reduces what is left for the house.
finance.form.existingDebtInterestHelp: The interest on that loan. It only affects how long the loan still runs, not the mortgage itself.
finance.form.rollOver: Put the freed payment into the mortgage
finance.form.rollOverHint: Once this loan is cleared, pay the same amount towards the house instead.
finance.form.propertyHelp: German purchase costs add roughly 9-15 % on top of the asking price.
finance.form.purchasePriceHelp: The asking price. Purchase costs come on top, and the loan is calculated from the total minus your equity.
finance.form.equityHelp: Your own money. It is deducted from the total cost, so every euro here is a euro less loan. Banks want at least the purchase costs covered.
finance.form.bundeslandHelp: Sets the transfer tax, which runs from 3.5 % to 6.5 % depending on the state. Picking a state overwrites the rate below.
finance.form.grunderwerbsteuerHelp: Transfer tax as a percentage of the purchase price. Prefilled from the state - override it if your contract says otherwise.
finance.form.notaryHelp: Notary and land registry, usually around 1.5 % of the price. Part of the purchase costs, which a bank rarely finances.
finance.form.maklerHelp: The agent's commission, shared between buyer and seller since 2020. Set it to 0 for a private sale.
finance.form.scenariosHelp: Compare several sets of terms. Tilgung and instalment set each other, so edit whichever you know.
finance.form.interestRateHelp: The Sollzins your bank quotes for the fixed period. Each scenario is one line on the charts, so you can see what half a percent costs you.
finance.form.tilgungHelp: How much of the loan you repay in the first year, as a percentage. More Tilgung means a bigger instalment and a much shorter term.
finance.form.fixedYearsHelp: How long the Sollzins is guaranteed. Whatever is left when it ends - the Restschuld - has to be refinanced at the rates of the day.
finance.form.sondertilgungHelp: An extra payment once a year, on top of the instalment. Most contracts allow up to 5 % of the loan, and it takes years off the term.
finance.kpi.monthlyRateDesc: Interest and repayment combined, at {{tilgung}} % Tilgung.
finance.kpi.payoffDesc: Time until the loan is repaid, at this rate and Sollzins.
finance.kpi.debtFreeAgeDesc: Your age when the last instalment is paid.
finance.kpi.restschuldDesc: Still owed after {{years}} years, to be refinanced at the rates of the day.
finance.kpi.totalInterestDesc: What the loan costs you over its full term.
finance.kpi.maxPriceDesc: Highest price that stays inside the 35 % rule.
finance.section.trajectoryHelp: The shaded years are your fixed-rate period. Its edge is what you refinance. Calculated at a constant Sollzins.
finance.section.milestonesHelp: When each stage of the repayment arrives.
finance.section.budgetHelp: The dashed line is the 35 % ceiling for housing and debt.
finance.section.splitHelp: Your payment stays flat, but its split shifts every year.
finance.section.costsHelp: The asking price is only part of the total.
finance.chart.noData: No data provided. Enter a purchase price to see the numbers.
finance.chart.noIncomeData: No data provided. Enter your household income to see the numbers.

finance.scatter.empty: No listings with a purchase price to score.
finance.scatter.axisYears: Years to pay off at your rate
finance.scatter.neverPaysOff: Your affordable rate never covers the interest
listings.filterAffordabilityHelp: Measured against your financing profile: housing plus existing debt at or below 35 % of your net income. Affordable up to {{price}}.
listings.filterAffordabilityRentHelp: Measured against your renting profile: warm rent plus existing debt at or below 35 % of your net income. Affordable up to {{price}} cold rent.
listings.filterAffordabilityBothHelp: Measured against your finance profile: housing plus existing debt at or below 35 % of your net income. Affordable up to {{rent}} cold rent, or {{price}} to buy.
listings.affordabilityTooltip.affordable: Within 35 % of your net income. Affordable up to {{price}}.
listings.affordabilityTooltip.stretch: Above your 35 % ceiling of {{price}}, but still payable.
listings.rentAffordabilityTooltip.afford: Warm rent within 35 % of your net income. Affordable up to {{price}} cold rent.
listings.rentAffordabilityTooltip.stretc: Above your comfortable rent of {{price}} cold, but still payable.
listings.rentAffordabilityTooltip.unaffo: Well past your affordable cold rent of {{price}}.

listing.detail.financeSetupHint: Want to know what this would cost you monthly?
listing.detail.rentSetupHint: Want to know if this rent fits your budget?

finance.warning.rateAboveAffordable: This rate is above the {{ceiling}} the 35 % rule allows you. Possible, but it leaves little room if anything changes.
finance.form.monthlyPaymentHelp: Interest and repayment together. Tilgung and instalment are the same quantity from opposite ends, so editing this rewrites the Tilgung.
